comparison.objective: Post a wet-floor sign before wiping a spill; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Carry and stand a sign, then press and sweep a sponge versus stabilize a narrow mandrel, strike it, withdraw safely, and retrieve fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Sign upright 6–20 cm from the spill before sponge contact, then grid-based wiping, versus four safe fractures and all released tangs in a tray.
comparison.reason: Procedural custodial hazard control and surface wiping do not test precision impact fracture or retained-coil protection.
